classic_finding__thiamine.subject: thiamine
classic_finding__thiamine.source: Thiamine deficiency causes Wernicke encephalopathy (confusion, ophthalmoplegia, ataxia).

classic_finding__niacin.subject: niacin
classic_finding__niacin.source: Pellagra (niacin deficiency) classically presents with the triad of dermatitis, diarrhea, and dementia.

deficiency_causes__cobalamin.subject: cobalamin
deficiency_causes__cobalamin.source: Cobalamin (vitamin B12) deficiency causes megaloblastic anemia.

classic_finding__cobalamin.subject: cobalamin
classic_finding__cobalamin.source: Vitamin B12 deficiency causes subacute combined degeneration of the spinal cord.

deficiency_causes__folate.subject: folate
deficiency_causes__folate.source: Folate (vitamin B9) deficiency causes megaloblastic anemia (without neurologic deficits).

classic_finding__folate.subject: folate
classic_finding__folate.source: Periconceptional folate deficiency is associated with fetal neural tube defects.

deficiency_causes__vitamin_c.subject: vitamin_c
deficiency_causes__vitamin_c.source: Vitamin C (ascorbic acid) deficiency causes scurvy.

classic_finding__vitamin_c.subject: vitamin_c
classic_finding__vitamin_c.source: Vitamin C is a cofactor for collagen hydroxylation; its deficiency impairs collagen synthesis.

deficiency_causes__vitamin_d.subject: vitamin_d
deficiency_causes__vitamin_d.source: Vitamin D deficiency causes rickets in children.

classic_finding__vitamin_d.subject: vitamin_d
classic_finding__vitamin_d.source: Vitamin D deficiency causes osteomalacia in adults.

deficiency_causes__vitamin_a.subject: vitamin_a
deficiency_causes__vitamin_a.source: Vitamin A deficiency causes night blindness (nyctalopia).

classic_finding__vitamin_a.subject: vitamin_a
classic_finding__vitamin_a.source: Vitamin A deficiency causes xerophthalmia and corneal damage.

deficiency_causes__vitamin_k.subject: vitamin_k
deficiency_causes__vitamin_k.source: Vitamin K deficiency causes a bleeding diathesis (coagulopathy).

classic_finding__vitamin_k.subject: vitamin_k
classic_finding__vitamin_k.source: Vitamin K deficiency prolongs the prothrombin time (PT/INR).
